definitionZh: 字体合成 CSS 的短手属性允许您指定浏览器在指定字体家族中缺失时是否可以合成粗体,斜体,小盖,和/或下标和上标类型面.
sourceDefinition: The font-synthesis CSS shorthand property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize the bold, italic, small-caps, and/or subscript and superscript typefaces when they are missing in the specified font-family.
